title: Fix Storybook build: remove duplicate Introduction.mdx
body:
Storybook build fails with `Unable to index` because two MDX files declare the same Meta title `"Getting Started/Introduction"`:

- `packages/components/src/stories-json/Introduction.mdx` (comprehensive, 128 lines)
- `packages/components/src/stories/Introduction.mdx` (shorter duplicate, 62 lines)

Both match the glob `../packages/**/src/**/*.mdx` in `.storybook/main.ts`, and Storybook's indexer cannot resolve duplicate titles.

- Removed the shorter duplicate (`stories/Introduction.mdx`), keeping the more complete version in `stories-json/`
